acquirer: Constant Contact, Inc. (backed by Clearlake Capital Group and Siris Capital Group)

deal_value.notes: All-cash transaction valued at approximately $240M including outstanding indebtedness; $17.10 per share, a 21% premium to the June 21, 2021 close of $14.11. Announced June 22, 2021; closed September 1, 2021.

calculable.calculation: $240M transaction value (incl. debt, per acquirer press release) / $29.3M SharpSpring FY2020 total revenue = 8.19x
inputs: Transaction value ~$240M including outstanding indebtedness - Constant Contact press release, Jun 22, 2021: https://news.constantcontact.com/2021-06-22-Clearlake-Capital-and-Siris-Backed-Constant-Contact-Agrees-to-Acquire-SharpSpring

SharpSpring FY2020 total revenue $29.3M (up 29% from $22.7M in 2019) - SharpSpring Q4/FY2020 results: https://investors.sharpspring.com/2021/sharpspring-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2020-results/
calculable.caveats: Trailing FY2020 revenue basis; the company-stated ~$240M transaction value (including debt) is used as the EV proxy. On a forward basis the multiple would be lower (analyst commentary around announcement cited roughly 7x FY2022E revenue, but that is soft/secondary).

sources.title: Constant Contact press release - Clearlake Capital and Siris-Backed Constant Contact Agrees to Acquire SharpSpring (Jun 22, 2021)
SharpSpring Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2020 Results
Yahoo Finance - SharpSpring to Be Acquired by Constant Contact for $240M

notes: Party naming verified: acquirer is Constant Contact (Clearlake- and Siris-backed), not Clearlake directly. Public target, so financials are on file: FY2020 revenue $29.3M is firm. No EV or revenue multiple was stated in the press release, SEC filings, or tier-1 coverage found; only analyst commentary (~7x FY2022E revenue) referenced a multiple, which is not counted as published.
